تختلبوا (form VIII)
# تَخْتَلِبُوا (taḵtalibū) /tax.ta.li.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
# تُخْتَلَبُوا (tuḵtalabū) /tux.ta.la.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِخْتَلَبَ (iḵtalaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
